high.title: Resident Deposits Exceed 10.5 Trillion VND, Setting New Record
high.summary: According to new data from the State Bank of Vietnam (SBV), resident deposits in the banking system reached over 10.56 trillion VND by the end of March 2026, up 2.19% from year-end 2025. Corporate and economic organization deposits reached over 6 trillion VND, down 2.69% from year-end 2025. In Q1/2026 alone, residents deposited an additional 200 trillion VND into the banking system, with year-on-year growth exceeding 3 trillion VND. This demonstrates continued preference for banks as a savings and asset preservation channel. The trend shows banks have abundant capital for lending operations, which could support economic growth but may also put pressure on deposit rates if loan demand remains weak.

high.title: Developing Capital Markets to "Share the Burden" with Banking System
high.summary: Vietnam's high economic growth target of over 10% annually during 2026-2030 requires massive medium and long-term capital for infrastructure, energy, digital transformation, and green transition. BIDV Deputy General Director estimates 2026 alone needs 4.9-5 trillion VND in capital (33-33.7% of GDP). With bank credit remaining the primary funding channel, developing capital markets to share the burden with the banking system becomes increasingly urgent. Key sectors like infrastructure and energy require projects worth tens of thousands of billions VND with long investment cycles. This highlights the critical need to develop government bond markets and corporate financing alternatives to reduce pressure on bank lending and interest rates.

high.title: One Bank Set to Pay 7.5% Stock Dividend, Rights Registration in June
high.summary: Bac A Bank (BAB) announced June 26, 2026 as the final registration date for shareholders to receive stock dividends. The bank plans to issue over 80.4 million shares as stock dividends at a 7.5% rate, meaning shareholders holding 100 shares will receive 7.5 new shares. Total issuance value reaches over 804 billion VND. After completion, the bank's charter capital is expected to increase from over 10.721 trillion VND to 11.525 trillion VND. This represents a significant capital injection that will strengthen the bank's capital adequacy ratios and lending capacity, which is positive for the banking sector's ability to support economic growth.

medium.title: Fed May Raise Interest Rates in 2026, Fulbright Expert Identifies Biggest Pressure on Vietnam
medium.summary: Fulbright expert Nguyen Xuan Thanh notes external shocks are changing interest rate adjustment roadmaps of major economies, especially the US. With US labor market remaining strong and inflation above expectations, the Fed may not cut rates this year and could even raise them. This impacts Vietnam through exchange rate pressure, export competitiveness, and international capital flows.

medium.title: Expert: VN-Index May Form Bottom Around 1,800 Points, Several Stock Groups Expected to Attract Funds
medium.summary: Vietnamese stock market completed its fourth consecutive week of decline with notable liquidity depletion. FIDT expert Bui Van Huy suggests the market faces adverse factors but shouldn't be overly pessimistic as much bad news is already priced in. VN-Index may form a bottom around 1,800 points as external pressures have been largely reflected in market movements.

medium.title: Mirae Asset Expert: World Cup Season Liquidity "Running Out of Steam", But Money on Stock Market Doesn't Disappear Due to This
medium.summary: Mirae Asset's Do Thanh Son notes World Cup 2026 has some impact on investor psychology and trading behavior, but it's not the sole reason for market liquidity decline. International studies show World Cup can significantly reduce trading volumes when national teams play, but this is temporary rather than permanent capital outflow from markets.

medium.title: Gold Prices Down 49 Million VND/Tael from Peak, One Seafood Company Unexpectedly Benefits Nearly 285 Billion VND
medium.summary: SJC gold prices peaked at 191.3 million VND/tael before falling to around 142.4 million VND/tael on June 12, 2026 - a decline of 48.9 million VND/tael (26%). This benefits APT as their gold-denominated debt obligation decreases in value. The company's debt includes 5,833 taels of SJC gold borrowed in 2009 when gold was only 17.7 million VND/tael.

medium.title: Vietnam's Exports to US Reach Nearly 70 Billion USD in 5 Months
medium.summary: Preliminary customs statistics show the US remains Vietnam's largest export market with nearly 70 billion USD in the first 5 months, up 21.7% year-on-year. Electronics and components led growth with 22.5 billion USD, up 54.9%. This strong export performance supports VND stability and demonstrates Vietnam's trade competitiveness despite global economic headwinds.
